english.title: Master of ship when goods are taken on board before ship entered outward from a port
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the master of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..), required by section 63 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 to be entered outwards from the port of **(..SPECIFY THE PORT..) when goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), were taken on board at that port except in accordance with a stiffening order before the ship was so entered
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
